concerns.text: T007r implements Holm-Bonferroni while FR-005 mandates 'the Bonferroni multiple-comparison correction'. The task only 'documents the deviation in the report's methodology block' — a runtime report note is not a spec amendment. The plan itself says the spec text is 'flagged for amendment', but no amendment exists, so the task silently relaxes a MUST-level FR. Amend spec.md FR-005/SC-003 first, or implement Bonferroni as specified.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001/T004 vs spec.md:Key Entities, Assumptions, FR-005
concerns.text: Spec contemplates modeling multiple properties (solubility, logP, boiling point; FR-005 and SC-003 reference 'N successfully modeled properties'). All tasks narrow the study to logP from ESOL only, with no spec amendment recording the scope reduction. With N=1 property the multiplicity correction (FR-005) is vacuous — a retroactive narrowing of the FR's stated scope.

Spec edge case requires 'chunking or subsampling logic' for extremely large molecules so shortest-path matrices fit in RAM; T001 instead silently excludes molecules with MW > 1000 Da. This changes required behavior from 'handle' to 'drop' with no recorded spec deviation. (T015b's sparse-matrix fallback partially covers this, but the MW filter is an additional undocumented exclusion criterion.)

SC-003 requires the family-wise error rate to be 'measured against the nominal alpha level (0.05)'. T007r only writes corrected p-values and controlled_alpha; no task produces an FWER measurement or comparison against alpha, so SC-003's acceptance criterion has no evidence-producing step. Either add a verification step or amend SC-003 to the achievable form (correction applied at controlled alpha).

Data model specifies diagnostics outputs at reports/diagnostics/vif_report.json and mi_report.json with a bonferroni_adjusted_p field; tasks write a single reports/metrics/diagnostics.json with different keys. Align the data model or the task deliverable paths/field names so the contract and tasks agree.

Plan states 'the study uses the full MoleculeNet ESOL dataset', but T001 filters MW > 1000 Da before modeling, so the analyzed set is a subset. Update the plan's scale claim or document the filter as a derivation step in the plan.
